providerDefault: MINIMAL on `gemini-3.1-flash-image` and `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image`; HIGH on `gemini-3-pro-image` (and HIGH is the only level it accepts)
summary: Trades image quality against latency by capping how much the model reasons before rendering. `gemini-3.1-flash-image` accepts `minimal` and `high` only, not `low` or `medium`.
combines: Supported on: Gemini 3 image models, Gemini Developer API. Not applicable to `gemini-2.5-flash-image`.
Thinking on the Gemini 3 image models is on by default and cannot be turned off through the API.
Thinking tokens are billed whether or not you read the thought output.
